summary: Independent source-pinned portable replay reproduced C3 E302 receipt and stdout byte-for-byte. Four exact source files, ten reported artifact hashes, all archive file members, seven independently reconstructed rasters and all 35 condensed station records were verified. Capsule/corridor measurement identity, crossing station failure despite global width40/mean0.8, shifted +7.5px pixel-edge convention, ragged local variation and tied width40/42 rows all reproduce. Existing figure matches raw evidence. Acceptance is technical reproducibility and scoped interpretation only.
